skill.name: kling-3-0
skill.description: Generate Kling 3.0 videos through RunComfy using Standard, Pro, or 4K text-to-video and image-to-video endpoints.
skill.summary: Create short Kling 3.0 videos with optional reference images, synchronized audio, and multi-shot direction.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, URL placeholders, or protected token storage. Single-quoted shell examples can expose substituted prompts to command injection, and the unpinned global CLI installation adds supply-chain risk. The skill can also trigger paid third-party generation without requiring cost confirmation.

remediation.issue: User prompt text is shown inside single-quoted shell JSON.
remediation.suggestion: Serialize input to a file or pass arguments without a shell. Never interpolate user text into a shell command.

remediation.issue: The prerequisite installs an unpinned npm CLI globally.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited CLI version and integrity value. Require explicit approval before any global installation.

remediation.issue: Paid generations can run without a mandatory cost confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Show the endpoint, duration, audio setting, and estimated price. Require confirmation before submitting each paid request.

semantic_findings.title: User Prompts Embedded in Shell-Quoted JSON
semantic_findings.description: Invocation examples place prompt text inside a single-quoted shell argument. Directly substituting user text containing an apostrophe can terminate quoting and inject shell syntax.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: All six shell examples wrap JSON in single quotes while the prompt is variable. The later no-injection claim does not address shell parsing before the CLI receives the argument.

semantic_findings.title: Billable Generation Lacks a Confirmation Gate
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs agents to invoke priced generation endpoints without requiring confirmation of tier, duration, audio surcharge, or estimated cost before submission.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file lists per-second prices and direct invocation steps but contains no mandatory approval step. Executing a generation can therefore create unintended external charges.

content.value_statement: Creating polished short videos requires selecting the correct model tier, mode, and settings. This skill prepares and runs Kling 3.0 generations through RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Selects Standard, Pro, or 4K rendering based on quality and cost requirements.
Runs text-to-video and image-to-video generation through six RunComfy endpoints.
Configures duration, aspect ratio, prompt guidance, seed, and optional synchronized audio.
Supports source and tail images for controlled image animation and final frames.
Structures multi-shot prompts with camera, motion, identity, and audio directions.
Downloads completed RunComfy video results to a chosen output directory.
limitations: Each generation is limited to 15 seconds.
Image-to-video requires a publicly accessible HTTPS image URL.
Only six documented aspect ratios are supported.
RunComfy access, network connectivity, credits, and local storage are required.

use_cases.title: Produce social video variants
use_cases.description: Create low-cost Standard clips in vertical, square, or widescreen formats for testing.

use_cases.title: Create polished campaign scenes
use_cases.description: Generate Pro multi-shot videos with stable characters, camera direction, and synchronized audio.

use_cases.title: Animate approved visual assets
use_cases.description: Turn product images or character artwork into controlled 1080p or 4K motion sequences.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 5-second Kling 3.0 Standard video of [scene]. Use [camera movement], a 16:9 frame, and no audio.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a reference image
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate [public image URL] for [duration]. Preserve [identity details], add [motion], and use a [aspect ratio] frame.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a multi-shot sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Kling 3.0 Pro sequence with [shot list]. Maintain [character anchors] and generate [dialogue, ambience, or music]. Confirm estimated cost first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a native 4K master
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft [concept] on Standard first. After approval, render 4K for [duration] with [shots], [audio], [negative constraints], and seed [number]. Confirm cost before each run.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced quality validation and final delivery

output_examples.input: Create a five-second widescreen sunrise over a coastal city with a slow aerial push and no audio.
output: Prepared a five-second 16:9 prompt with slow aerial movement.
Requested confirmation before submitting the paid generation.

output_examples.input: Animate this product image in Pro quality while preserving the logo and adding a gentle turntable motion.
output: Preserved the product shape and logo while limiting motion to a controlled rotation.
Validated that the source image uses a public HTTPS URL.

output_examples.input: Create a ten-second 4K three-shot restaurant scene with dialogue and city ambience.
output: Selected Kling 3.0 4K text-to-video with synchronized audio.
Structured three numbered shots with consistent characters and sound direction.
Presented the estimated price and requested approval before submission.

best_practices: Confirm the endpoint, duration, audio setting, and estimated cost before generation.
Validate concepts with Standard before rendering expensive Pro or 4K versions.
Describe camera movement, subject motion, stable identity details, and audio separately.
anti_patterns: Do not place unescaped user text directly inside a shell command.
Do not request unsupported durations or aspect ratios.
Do not submit private, sensitive, or inaccessible image URLs.

faq.question: Which Kling 3.0 tiers are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports Standard, Pro, and native 4K tiers for text-to-video and image-to-video.

faq.question: What is the maximum clip duration?
faq.answer: Every supported endpoint accepts clips from 3 to 15 seconds.

faq.question: Can the skill generate synchronized audio?
faq.answer: Yes. Audio can include dialogue, ambience, or music when generation audio is enabled.

faq.question: Can I animate a local image file?
faq.answer: No. RunComfy requires a publicly accessible HTTPS URL for image-to-video inputs.

faq.question: Does generation cost money?
faq.answer: Yes. Pricing depends on tier, duration, and audio settings. Confirm the estimated cost before submission.

faq.question: Where are completed videos saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads completed videos into the output directory selected for the request.
